title: NoiseBankRunRecord
description: Provenance sidecar for a NoiseBank HDF5 file: how the noise segments were extracted (calibration, threshold strategy, filter band, windowing) plus per-trace provenance arrays aligned to the bank's traces. Schema version 1.0. Written as a sibling JSON file next to the bank with a matching name stem (e.g. iafdb_noise_v1.h5 + iafdb_noise_v1_run_record.json), following the same convention as metrics.csv + run.json in egm-classifier. The mixer never opens this file; debuggers, reproducibility audits, and the white paper's methods section do.

schema_version.description: Schema version in X.Y form. X (major) bumps at release; Y (minor) bumps on every dev-time structural change. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at write time. Should match (or closely follow) the sibling bank's created_utc.

source.description: Free-form provenance tag for the upstream dataset, identical to the sibling bank's source field. Producers stamp the same value in both files.

description.description: Free-form human-readable note about how this bank was built — strategy params, dataset slice, anything that helps a reader reproduce or understand the run. Default empty.

fs_hz.description: Sampling rate in Hz. Mirrors the sibling bank's fs_hz; carried here so the run record stands alone as documentation.

window_samples.description: Window length in samples. Cross-field invariant: window_samples == round(window_ms * 1e-3 * fs_hz).

hop_ms.description: Stride between adjacent windows in milliseconds.

band_hz.description: Band-pass filter edges in Hz, [low, high], applied before peak-to-peak computation. Defaults to the clinical 30-300 Hz bipolar EGM band so noise is characterised in the same band the classifier sees.

calibration.description: How signal amplitude was calibrated before threshold selection.

method.description: Calibration scheme. Open string (not enum) so any source's calibration is representable: 'r_wave_anchoring' (IAFDB), 'none' (raw signal pass-through), 'fixed_gain' (PhysioNet header gain only), future methods. When 'none', peak_to_peak_mv in this file is in raw signal units rather than mV.

target_qrs_pp_mv.description: Target peak-to-peak QRS amplitude in mV against which each source record was calibrated. Null when method has no notion of a target (e.g., 'none' or 'fixed_gain').

selection.description: Threshold strategy used to select quiet windows.

threshold_mode.description: Strategy. 'absolute' = keep windows with peak-to-peak ≤ threshold_value mV (requires calibrated input). 'percentile' = keep windows in the bottom threshold_value%% of the pooled per-record p-p distribution (scale-invariant).

source_records.description: Record names from the upstream dataset that contributed at least one segment to the bank (e.g., 'iaf1_afw'). Allows zero entries (empty bank is valid).

per_trace_provenance.description: Optional parallel arrays of per-trace audit fields aligned to the bank's traces (index i here corresponds to bank traces row i). Producers SHOULD write this for any bank intended for paper-citable use; smaller test fixtures may omit it. Consumers that need patient-aware sampling or unit-aware mixing read these arrays; the v1 mixer ignores them entirely.

patient_id.description: (N,) Source-dataset patient identifier for each trace. No pattern constraint.

start_sample.description: (N,) Sample offset of the segment in its source record. Combined with patient_id + the bank's source_record + windowing.window_samples, uniquely identifies the trace's location in the raw source data.

peak_to_peak_mv.description: (N,) Band-passed peak-to-peak amplitude that passed the threshold. Real mV when calibration.method calibrated the input; raw signal units when calibration.method='none'.

calibration_scalar.description: (N,) Per-record calibration scalar applied to this segment. signal_in_mv = signal_raw * calibration_scalar. When calibration.method='none' producers SHOULD write 1.0 here so consumers don't accidentally rescale.
